title: Abandoned Factory // Zombie Field // Tibetan MountainTop
content: These Are Some Dreams I’ve had in MallWorld a couple of time; these times, it was an apocalypse. It was so real that I felt met real people in here: Scenario 1: Desolate Factory. Many stories tall, probably at least 16. Tall warehouse type building, two of them side by side. Most of the edges and roofs are torn off, almost apocalyptic. Lots of stairs and ladders between layers, makeshift wooden ladders, and original concrete stairs. It’s dark out. Old worn out sort of feeling. There are people living in different rooms, almost all of them have serious issues or something about them that makes me “almost” not recognize that they exist, except an eerie feeling that they are there. I leave them alone. I keep climbing. Up the layers. I meet several friends in the upper layers, but I don’t know who they are. They seem in a similar confused state as I am, and I assume that I know them but I am too confused to recognize them. Imagine pitch blackness surrounding a double story warehouse. Maybe it was bigger before, but there are only 10-20 layers left in the aftermath of an apocalypse. Suffocating darkness everywhere. But still, I find who I think are friends. I make acquaintances, and I ride the dark vibe. I find myself falling in love with the comfort of this abandoned building, not wanting to leave. I also find that I want nothing to do with it, and I can’t wait to get back to “reality”. I wake up, certain I’ve been to this place several times before. Scenario 2: Zombie world. Huge, unfathomable open field. Dead grass with dew and fog as far as the eye can see. It’s as light out as Alaska on a foggy day. I’m on a wooden barrack. Two stories high. There are stairs that lead to my guard post. My companions somehow communicate (radio, telepathic, dream doesn’t specify) that I need to go to the other edge of this infinite field to check something out. Something serious has occurred. I run faster than humanly possibly to the other edge of the infinite dead field. I see hundreds of thousands of zombies breaking through a gate. They are chasing me. They drive me all the way back across the field of peace and terror. I rush up to the top of the wooden barracks and they begin to spill up the tower. I wake up. Scenario 3: A “Paradise” in the mountains. I’m sure I’m in China. Or the remote mountains of Tibet. This is what it feels like. There is a very long path up a winding hill to the top. I pass a tall Watch Tower made of old, crumbling stone. I stop there and meet some friends who I feel are knights or guardians of some sort. The dream continues another night. I keep trudging up the mountain, and I arrive at this huge, ancient, megalithic building. It’s made of gigantic Black rocks. Inside the building I see a large hall where thousands of people are gathered together celebrating. People have animals here, bulls, dogs, exotic creatures, and they all engage in music and love and debauchery in the center of a large rectangular “dancefloor” resembling the size of a football field. They seem artificially happy, lost in their ways, unaware of the beauty outside that I am about to see. There are luxurious lights and crystals, and every sort of fancy thing you can dream of. A true utopia. Then I walk up the stairs, and out of the building to reach the peak of the mountain. There is a small gondola here which overlooks the surrounding country. It is the most beautiful thing I have ever seen. There are purple and yellow mountains with the setting sun, clouds below and above me. Most stretching into the distance, and all I can see in the distance is the earth, and nature, with no influence of mankind’s destructions. I am on top of the word. With it, comes a very sad, very lonely feeling. A feeling like there is nobody else left in the world, and this is the end of all things; yet I am at peace. Please let me know if any of these seem familiar or if you have had similar dreams.
